requirements.title: XROGA REPOSITORY TRUTH MAP AND ARCHITECTURE INVENTORY
requirements.description:
Create a reproducible, machine-readable and human-readable truth map of the CURRENT Xroga repository. Do not redesign Xroga in this command. Establish what really exists, what is reachable, what is partially implemented, what is placeholder-only, what is dead/unreachable, and what remains unverified.

Repository:
Xroga/xroga.com

Core rule:
Do not trust prior documentation, prior prompts, filenames, or architectural claims until they are verified against the checked-out repository. Record the actual HEAD SHA at execution time. Never hard-code the SHA from an earlier research session as current truth.
requirements.user_need: Close the "we do not know exactly what we already have" problem so every following Xroga command can make evidence-based KEEP / EXTEND / REPLACE / DEPRECATE decisions.
